parameters.name: AccessInstanceName
parameters.description: The name of the private instance.

parameters.name: FirewallType
parameters.description:
The type of the cloud firewall. Valid values:
- **internet**
- **vpc**
- **nat**

parameters.name: MemberUid
parameters.description: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud member accounts.

parameters.name: PrimaryDns
parameters.description:
The primary DNS server.
> When PrivateDnsType is set to Custom, you must specify PrimaryDns and StandbyDns.

parameters.name: PrimaryVSwitchId
parameters.description: The ID of the primary vSwitch. The zone of PrimaryVSwitchId and StandbyVSwitchId must be a zone that supports private DNS. Otherwise, an error is returned. The region must also be in the supported list.

parameters.name: PrimaryVSwitchIp
parameters.description: The IP address of the primary vSwitch.

parameters.name: PrivateDnsType
parameters.description:
The type of private DNS. When PrivateDnsType is set to Custom, Port and IpProtocol are required. When PrivateDnsType is set to PrivateZone, the backend automatically sets the port to 53 and uses the default protocol. Valid values:
- **PrivateZone**
- **Custom** (default)

parameters.name: RegionNo
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance.

parameters.name: StandbyDns
parameters.description:
The secondary DNS server.

> When PrivateDnsType is set to Custom, you must specify PrimaryDns and StandbyDns.

parameters.name: StandbyVSwitchId
parameters.description: The ID of the secondary vSwitch. The zone of PrimaryVSwitchId and StandbyVSwitchId must be a zone that supports private DNS. Otherwise, error code -200534 is returned. The region must also be in the supported list.

parameters.name: StandbyVSwitchIp
parameters.description: The IP address of the secondary vSwitch.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the VPC-connected instance.
